newsitem.title: USA: Mednet MPC sees loss, to restate results.
newsitem.headline: Mednet MPC sees loss, to restate results.

text.p: Mednet MPC Corp said Wednesday that it was restating results for its first three quarters, which it said would affect the profitability in the first quarter and subsequent periods.
It said it is expecting a fourth quarter charge of more than $13 million from a reevaluation of intangible assets and an operating loss for the year.
It said revenue for 1996 should be about $93 million, lower than November projections of $100 to $110 million.
For 1997, the company said it expects lower sales but improved net performance.

Additionally, it said its Nevada pharmacy license has been put on probation as a result of proceedings brought by the Nevada State Board of Pharmacy in July of 1996 for violations in the operation of its Nevada mail order pharmacy.

The company said has closed its Chicago-based dispensing facility and consolidated its operations into its Las Vegas facility. It said the move should reduce annual operating costs by about $2.5 million.
